meta.reading: ceiling-normalised is the comparable view: the two indexes' achievable maxima differ (old 0.8806 / new 0.9545, §I58), so a raw recall delta compares different denominators.
meta.what: §I59 — the base MRL-64 lane (dense_64 @1000, the only stage facing the whole corpus) on BOTH indexes, each with its own query embedder
meta.why_each_index_gets_its_own_embedder: the named vectors are dense_768 (Nomic MRL) on the old index and dense_1024 (Qwen3 MRL) on the new one — different embedding spaces, so a Qwen3 64d vector is meaningless against the old index's dense_64. The delta is therefore EMBEDDER + INDEX TOGETHER, not one of them.
